caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular box with a hinged lid that is partially open, revealing two circular objects set into the top interior of the box, each with a central hole. The box has rounded corners and stands on four small spherical feet. It is rendered in pencil on an off-white background, with detailed shading used to indicate depth and articulation of the box, lid, and circular objects. The main box and lid have a uniform texture and shading, suggesting a metallic or smooth surface. Two inset diagrams are included in the top-right and bottom-left corners of the drawing, each composed of lines and numerical notations indicating dimensions, but without further written description. The drawing is bordered with a single line rectangular frame. The overall composition maintains a technical and schematic style, focusing on the proportions and construction details of the box and its components.
title: Inkwell
